landing.honestyTitle: What is real and what is not

honesty.simulated: This is a demonstration. Centres, weekly reports, child counts and estimates are simulated for Gicumbi and clearly labelled "simulated data" wherever they appear.
honesty.real: District and sector boundaries are real public data (NISR via geoBoundaries). The stunting figure for Gicumbi is the published RDHS 2025 value; sector values around it are simulated.
honesty.phase2: Phase 2 loads the Census, EICV7, DHS, Labour Force Survey, education statistics and NCDA's register into the same structures.
honesty.privacy: No child names, photos or IDs are ever collected. Parent locations are rounded to a 500 m square.

methodology.title: How it works
methodology.lead: The full data process, from sources to the decision a person takes, and what is real today versus simulated.

sources.title: Sources
sources.what: Official statistics, public maps and partner registers.
sources.today: Real boundaries; everything else simulated for Gicumbi.
sources.phase2: Census 2022, EICV7, DHS 2025, LFS 2025, education yearbook, NCDA register, WorldPop, OpenStreetMap.

alignment.title: Alignment
alignment.what: Every source is matched to sectors with its year, origin and checks.
alignment.today: The demo generator writes the same tables with origin = simulated.
alignment.phase2: One adapter per source, with checks that must pass before loading.

models.title: Models
models.what: Need per sector with ranges, coverage within walking distance, early warning.
models.today: Explainable baselines: stored estimates, straight-line catchments, rules against each centre's own history.
models.phase2: Small-area estimation calibrated to official totals, walking-time catchments, anomaly detection.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.what: A ranked shortlist within the budget, with reasons, ranges and sources.
suggestions.today: Greedy maximal coverage with your policy weights; compared with a largest-population-first baseline.
suggestions.phase2: An exact optimisation model behind the same screen.

decision.title: Human decision
decision.what: Approve, edit or reject. Rejections need a reason.
decision.today: Fully working, with an audit log that cannot be edited.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.what: Weekly reports, parent requests and rejection reasons shape the next round.
feedback.today: Rejections become constraints; parent requests raise a site's value; reports drive alerts.
feedback.phase2: Models retrained on what decisions and reports show.
